UG Course Offered
Course of Study :-
Three year Degree (spread across six semesters) in Choice Based Credit System (CBCS)
The college is going to start TDC course in CBCS as per guideline given by Gauhati University.
The following tables indicate the requirements for successful completion of under – graduate degree in CBCS system:
CORE COURSE & GENERIC SUBJECT
Political Science, Education, Philosophy, Economics, History, Elective Assamese, Elective Bengali, Elective Hindi, Sanskrit, Arabic, Information Technology.
HONOURS SUBJECTS
Assamese, Bengali, Hindi, English, Political Science, Education, Philosophy, Economics, Sanskrit, Arabic, History.
BCA
Requirements for successful completion of UG degree:
Degree
Minimum Requirements
Undergraduate Degree with Honours (all disciplines)
English
Undergraduate degree in Humanities / Social Science
14 Core papers in that discipline
2 Skill Enhancement Courses (Minimum)
4 Discipline Specific Elective
4 Generic Elective Papers
4 Core papers each in two disciplines of choice.
2 Core papers each in English and MIL/Alt respectively.
2 Ability Enhancement Compulsory Courses.
4 Skill Enhancement Courses (Minimum)
2 Papers each from a list of Discipline specific
Elective papers based on the two disciplines of Choice selected above. DSE
2 Papers from the list of Generic Electives papers.
